origin.families: Equivalent spellings of the same work. Every member of a family prints the same output at each scale, so outputs are checked exactly and timings compare like with like.
origin.rules: R1 constants with different bit patterns; R2 value expressions and temporaries; R3 an unrelated statement; R4 independent statement order; R5 extracted functions; R6 data from parameters or results; R7 compound and expanded assignment; R8 loop step spellings.
origin.scales: Templates replace each @NAME@ placeholder. Native scales match the hand-written C reference; VM scales are smaller and also expand the family's Lua reference.
origin.lua: Each family's Lua 5.x reference does the same work at the VM scale in idiomatic Lua and prints the VM output.
origin.seeds: The push and inplace seeds expand to the exact bytes of the fixed Array gate programs.

limits.source: Task345 decisions: slowest / fastest member <= 1.5 for native and VM; every native member <= 3x the hand-written C; the fastest member meets the family's own C limit. Task351: every VM member <= 1.5x the family's Lua reference.

push.limitSource: Task339 M2 managed values: native <= 1.3 C.

inplace.limitSource: Exclusive-access decision section 5.4: in-place updates <= 1.1 raw C.

append.limitSource: Task328 P3 managed-value target: native <= 1.3 C.

map.limitSource: Task328 P3 managed-value target: native <= 1.3 C.

sieve.limitSource: Task351: strided in-place Array writes and reads <= 1.3 C, the generic managed-value limit.
